newsitem.title: DENMARK: Quiet Danish shares rebound, more gains in store.
newsitem.headline: Quiet Danish shares rebound, more gains in store.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Tuesday after recovering from early falls with dealers foreseeing quiet, unchanged conditions on Wednesday with more gains in store and the KFX tipped to put on another quarter point.
"We expect an unchanged, calm market tomorrow with the possibility of more modest rises," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index gained 0.41 point to close at 119.77 in overall bourse turnover of 732 million crowns. The KFX September future rose 0.20 point to 120 with 163 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Tele Danmark was in focus ahead of its 1996 first-half rsult due Thursday morning, finishing one crown up at 276 in 475,000 share volume.

East Asiatic closed 2.20 crowns higher at 117 on a better than expected interim pre-tax result, while insurer Topdanmark ended 20 crowns up at 630 on greatly improved profits for the year's first six months. The Topdanmark share traded at 625 though just before its result was announced.
